name: Moving MNIST
summary: 将 MNIST 数字在画布中按速度移动并反弹生成的经典视频预测基准，可按需生成确定或随机轨迹，长期用于验证时序表征、外推和不确定未来建模。
summaryEn: A classic video-prediction benchmark generated by moving MNIST digits across a canvas with boundary collisions, widely used for temporal representation and uncertain-future modeling.
scaleZh: 1 万条标准测试序列 · 每条 20 帧 · 64×64 像素
license: Generated benchmark; MNIST source-data terms apply
licenseZh: 生成式基准；同时适用 MNIST 源数据条款
verdict: 经典视频预测入门基准
wmNote: 规模小、结构简单，适合快速验证时序模型；不应被用来代表真实世界视觉和复杂物理。
wmNoteEn: Small and simple enough for rapid validation, but not representative of real-world appearance or complex physics.
